short_description: Mental health EHR with integrated insurance billing, optional managed RCM services, and flexible client-based pricing through Ensora Health.
long_description: TheraNest Billing provides mental health practices with comprehensive insurance billing capabilities integrated into the TheraNest practice management platform. Now part of Ensora Health (formerly Therapy Brands), TheraNest offers flexible billing options ranging from self-service electronic claims submission to fully managed RCM services. The platform includes electronic claims through Office Ally or Apex EDI clearinghouses, real-time eligibility verification, ERA auto-posting, and patient billing features. TheraNest uses a client-based pricing model rather than per-provider pricing, making it cost-effective for practices with many part-time clinicians. The optional Managed Billing service provides full-service RCM with a dedicated team handling claims submission, denial management, and AR follow-up at a percentage of collections. Ensora Health's acquisition has expanded integration possibilities across their behavioral health software portfolio.

faqs.q: How much does TheraNest charge for insurance billing?
faqs.a: TheraNest's self-service billing is included in the monthly subscription ($39-91/month based on active clients). Claims are submitted through Office Ally clearinghouse at no additional per-claim fee. For practices wanting full-service billing, TheraNest's Managed Billing service charges 5-7% of collections.

TheraNest Managed Billing is a full-service RCM option where a dedicated billing team handles claims submission, denial management, AR follow-up, and patient collections on your behalf. The service charges 5-7% of collected revenue, eliminating the need for in-house billing staff or expertise.

faqs.q: Is TheraNest part of Therapy Brands / Ensora Health?
faqs.a: Yes, TheraNest was acquired by Therapy Brands, which has since rebranded as Ensora Health. Ensora Health owns multiple behavioral health software platforms including TheraNest, Therabill, CounSol, and others, offering integration possibilities across their portfolio.

faqs.q: What clearinghouse does TheraNest use for claims?
faqs.a: TheraNest primarily uses Office Ally as their clearinghouse partner for electronic claims submission, which is free for basic claim submission. Some integrations also support Apex EDI. Office Ally connects to most commercial payers, Medicare, and Medicaid programs nationwide.
